title: Canonical local finite coefficient adjoints
statement: Use finite fields [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] and internal coefficient modules [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. For f:X→T, a finite E, an f*Omega-module M and a local model P over g*f*E with any map a:Omega tensor_E P→g*M, construct for every F≥E the specified F tensor_E P, its tensor-transitivity map to g*M, and its scalar adjoint q into g*Res_FOmega M. The tensor adjunct of q is the tensor-transitivity map; if a is an isomorphism then this map is invertible and q is monic. All data are explicit constructions.

source.place: (Obj) descent paragraph, finite-stage comparisons on pairwise overlaps

proof.text: Use the already proved coefficient-linear projection Omega→F. Apply the three strong monoidal inverse images from the profinite point to T, X and the local scheme. Mapping preserves its linearity and retraction equations. The balanced tensor construction gives a natural retraction of the scalar-extension unit. A morphism with a retraction is monic.

Construct the extended model and tensor-transitivity map as before. Define the local adjunct underlying map explicitly as the mixed-scalar comparison followed by the original map. The scalar-unit identities and uniqueness of scalar adjunction prove equality to the previous canonical adjunct, hence linearity. Package the module map from that named linearity theorem. Rewrite the existing monomorphism and scalar-adjunction arguments using the equality to the canonical adjunct. The scalar_unit and mixedScalarMap_unit identities are stated once here and imported by the overlap transpose proof.
